items.title: TRT injections vs. creams vs. pellets
items.summary: If you’ve been approved for testosterone replacement therapy (TRT) to address your low testosterone levels, the next step would be to choose your method of administration: TRT injections vs. creams vs. pellets. Each of these testosterone replacement therapy delivery methods have distinct pros and cons.

items.title: How testosterone declines with age
items.summary: As you get older, your body changes, and your testosterone levels are no exception. Testosterone declines in men gradually with age, starting at around 40 years old and at a rate of approximately 1% to 2% per year.

items.title: Glyphosate, sperm, and male fertility: What you need to know
items.summary: Exposure to glyphosate (AKA Roundup) may impair male fertility.We’ll walk through what you need to know when it comes to glyphosate exposure and sperm health, and how you can best protect your sperm.

items.title: ICSI vs. conventional IVF: Which option is right for you?
items.summary: ICSI refers to a specialized form of IVF, in which a single live sperm is injected directly into the center of an egg, unlike in IVF, when thousands of sperm and one to two eggs are mixed in a single dish so the sperm can swim and penetrate the egg(s) just as they do during natural fertilization.

items.title: Vasectomy reversal vs. IVF: Which option is right for you?
items.summary: While vasectomies are intended as a permanent form of male sterilization and birth control, vasectomy reversal is possible — but it’s not the only option. IVF with sperm retrieval can be a fertility after vasectomy “workaround.”

items.title: Top 4 fertility protocols for men on testosterone replacement therapy (TRT)
items.summary: If you’re undergoing testosterone replacement therapy (or thinking about it), you should be aware of how this treatment will affect your fertility, especially if you wish to have children in the future. TRT and fertility do not generally mix well together — when you introduce synthetic or lab-manufactured testosterone into your body, your brain assumes your natural testosterone levels are adequate.

items.title: Can my partner help me produce a sample for sperm testing?
items.summary: If you’re getting ready to test your sperm, you might be wondering — Can my wife help me collect a sperm sample? How does the semen analysis process work? And what should I not do before my test to ensure I get the most accurate result?

items.title: The cost of sperm freezing and banking
items.summary: We’ll walk you through what different options can entail so you can feel more confident about your decision. You might be surprised with how accessible sperm banking costs can be.

items.title: How to use your frozen sperm with Legacy
items.summary: This article will take you through the steps of how to withdraw your sperm with Legacy, the cost of sperm withdrawal, and what options you have for using your frozen sperm.

items.title: Male fertility after age 35: What changes (and what doesn’t)?
items.summary: The myth that only women have a biological clock is misleading, but the research tells a more nuanced story. Male fertility after 35 does change, even if it doesn't come with the age cutoffs often associated with female reproductive aging. More American men are becoming fathers later than ever before:…

items.title: A modern man’s guide to family planning
items.summary: Today, men are thinking carefully about when and how to have children, balancing career goals, relationships, and biological realities. Understanding male fertility, planning for fatherhood, and considering options like sperm freezing can empower men to make informed choices.

items.title: Average age of fathers in the United States: Paternal age trends in the latest data (2026)
items.summary: How old are American dads? Men are becoming fathers later in life, a trend that's been building for decades and shows no signs of slowing down. Let’s explore the average age of fathers in 2026, and break that down to explore paternal age in major US cities, compare US paternal age vs. other countries, and understand the potential fertility and pregnancy impacts of older fathers.

items.title: Can trans women recover fertility after gender-affirming hormone therapy? A provider’s guide to the research
items.summary: Reviewing the latest guidelines around fertility counseling and preservation for trans and gender nonconforming patients from the World Professional Association for Transgender Health, the American Society for Reproductive Medicine, and other professional organizations.

items.title: Legacy partners with Upstream Fertility to support fertility pilot for active-duty service members and Veterans
items.summary: Upstream, the first personalized sperm health program for men, announces a pilot program in partnership with Legacy, Military Family Building Coalition (MFBC), and SiPhox Health launching October 15. The program will track improvements in sperm health among five active-duty service members and Veterans over a 10-week period, combining advanced diagnostics with personalized lifestyle coaching.

items.title: Personalized supplements for health, vitality, and fertility: Q&A with Dean Kelly, CEO of Gainful
items.summary: We talk to Dean about Gainful’s commitment to clean ingredients, how protein can benefit men’s health and those taking weight loss medications, and Dean’s advice for those hoping to give their lifestyle a healthier boost.

items.title: Medication for male fertility
items.summary: While an infertility diagnosis can be discouraging, there are a number of sperm-boosting drugs and supplements that can help improve male fertility issues. Find out what these medications and supplements are and learn more about what causes male-factor infertility in the first place.

items.title: Antibiotics and sperm quality
items.summary: Some common antibiotics may affect sperm or even contribute to infertility. We’ll take a look at antibiotics’ uses and their effect on sperm.

items.title: Age and male fertility
items.summary: Stories of men in their 60s or older fathering children tend to fuel the idea that male fertility is eternal, but that’s a misconception. Men also experience the effects of aging with a decrease in fertility over time. To some extent, men—just like women—face a biological clock.

items.title: How long does sperm last?
items.summary: Let’s explore how long sperm can live in different scenarios, and bust a few myths along the way.
